scope: Determine whether the 11-pixel lower-arrow difference in the existing SR10.4 capture comes from the GTK2 palette bundle currently selected by user lsi.

method.scale: 1:1 RGB; no registration offset, filtering, or normalization
method.reference_cell: 15x15 down-arrow cell at (4,242) in the retained SR10.4 normal crop
method.palette_asset: Compare the installed generated down-normal 15x15 asset directly with the SR10.4 normal cell.

interpretation: The selected GTK2 palette bundle's normal down-arrow is an exact 0/225 match to the normal SR10.4 reference, so the installed static normal asset does not explain the active File Manager's 11-pixel row difference. In the same VUE capture, the inactive lower window matches the reference exactly. This establishes a context-correlated VUE state difference, but does not identify whether focus, sensitivity, or another widget state caused it. Do not change GTK2 artwork from this evidence.
limits: This is offline analysis of existing captures and the installed bundle; no MAME input or application restart occurred.
The two VUE controls were not independently tested for focus or sensitivity.
Pressed/released historical comparison and manual visual acceptance remain open.
next: Keep the GTK2 palette unchanged. Continue the state-paired comparison only after I517 has user.authorized=true for its current definition hash.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: The current installed normal asset is confirmed exact against SR10.4; the captured context difference remains unexplained and held-state evidence/visual acceptance remain open. This is not a visual-fidelity score.
